de: Second Northern War: Naval forces of the Dutch Republic defeat the Swedes in the Battle of the Sound.

te: Valentinian III, Western Roman Emperor, marries Licinia Eudoxia, daughter of his cousin Theodosius II, Eastern Roman Em…
dz: 瓦伦丁活佛三世,西罗马皇帝,嫁给了利西尼亚·尤多西亚(Licinia Eudoxia),他堂弟西奥多修斯二世的女儿,东罗马皇帝在君士坦丁堡统一了西奥多修斯宫的两个分支.
de: Valentinian III, Western Roman Emperor, marries Licinia Eudoxia, daughter of his cousin Theodosius II, Eastern Roman Emperor in Constantinople unifying the two branches of the House of Theodosius.

te: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, stages a grand adventus in the…
dz: 君士坦丁大帝在米尔维安桥战役胜利后进入罗马，在城中上演了一场盛大的冒险，受到了民众的欢呼。马克森提乌斯的尸体被从台伯河中打捞出来并被斩首。
de: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, stages a grand adventus in the city, and is met with popular jubilation. Maxentius' body is fished out of the Tiber and beheaded.
